# Joplin MCP for Claude

> Open-source bridge that connects Claude and any MCP client to self-hosted
> Joplin notes. OAuth for hosted Claude is built into the server (GitHub login,
> no separate OAuth proxy); other clients use local stdio or Streamable HTTP
> MCP. One installer sets up the complete headless Linux stack, and two-way
> Markdown sync makes broad changes reviewable.

Canonical documentation: https://joplin-mcp.romancello.net/
Source: https://github.com/kogeler/joplin-md-sync
Package: https://pypi.org/project/joplin-md-sync/

<!-- pages -->

## Agent safety

- Pull before editing.
- Keep managed metadata headers intact.
- Review a three-way diff and `push --dry-run` before a real push.
- Do not edit `.joplin-sync/`.
- Do not interleave MCP writes with unpushed local edits.
- Do not expose the Joplin Data API to a network.
- Never put a Joplin, MCP, GitHub OAuth, sync, or encryption credential in
  chat, Git, logs, or command arguments.
